ENERGY EFFICIENCY SOLUTIONS FOR BERGEN COUNTY HOMES

Rising energy costs throughout New Jersey make efficiency improvements increasingly important for homeowners. Modern heating and cooling systems operate at efficiency levels that would have seemed impossible just a decade ago. Variable-speed furnaces adjust output based on actual heating needs, reducing energy consumption while maintaining consistent temperatures. High-efficiency air conditioning units with SEER ratings above 16 can reduce cooling costs by up to 40 percent compared to older models. We offer free estimates on installation services, helping you understand the potential savings and return on investment for new equipment.

Heat pump systems: These versatile units provide both heating and cooling, operating efficiently even in temperatures as low as minus five degrees Fahrenheit
Smart thermostats: Programmable controls learn your schedule and preferences, automatically adjusting temperatures to maximize comfort and minimize waste
Zoning systems: Individual temperature control for different areas allows you to heat or cool only occupied spaces, reducing overall energy consumption

WHAT MAKES US UNIQUE

At First Choice Plumbing, Heating, Air Conditioning & Electrical, we believe that quality workmanship, dedicated customer service, and comprehensive solutions make our business stand out.

Our mission is to be more than just a plumbing, HVAC installation, and maintenance company. Whether it’s a furnace tune-up or AC repair, our decades of experience ensure a comprehensive evaluation and customized solution for all your plumbing and HVAC needs.

With decades of combined experience, our trusty team will identify the problem and design a more efficient alternative. We are committed to high-quality workmanship with a proactive approach.

Across Middlesex, Somerset Counties, and beyond, we are your one-stop solution to plumbing, heating, and air conditioning needs. From maintenance and repair through to new installations, we offer a full suite of services for residential properties.

“In addition to scheduled service, our 24/7/365 emergency repair is there when you need us most! No matter the issue, our prompt and courteous team will work hard to solve your problem as quickly as possible. With tremendous skill and exceptional customer care at the heart of what we do, First Choice Plumbing, Heating & Air Conditioning is the first choice for local plumbing, heating, and A/C services in NJ.”

OUR PHILOSOPHY

Personal Attention

Every client receives dedicated support and follow-through.

Client Participation

We believe collaboration leads to the best outcomes.

Creative Solutions

We solve problems with innovation and practicality.

Expert Professionalism

Our team upholds the highest standards on every project.
